screenText:
RULE 1
NEVER TAKE CASH YOU CAN’T EXPLAIN
caption: Three a.m. The last night clerk left a list under the register. Laminated. No name. Rule number one... Never take cash you can't explain.
At 3:12, a man in a gray coat slides an envelope across the counter. Five hundred dollars. He says, "Just ring up a pack of gum." The list says: Banks ask. Feds ask harder.
Rule two. The camera over the register is not the one that matters.

screenText:
RULE 3
LYING TO A FEDERAL AGENT IS A CRIME
18 U.S.C. § 1001
caption: The gray coat is gone. The next customer is a woman in a dark suit. Badge on her belt. She doesn't buy anything. Did you see anyone here tonight? Every answer is either the truth or a crime.
Cash on hand, four thousand two hundred ten. Logged, zero. Suspicion, six percent. Someone else has been counting too.

screenText:
RULE 4
DON'T BE THE ONE WHO STAYS
caption: Under the list, in handwriting that looks like yours... Rule four. Don't be the one who stays.

screenText:
PART 2 TOMORROW
COMMENT TAKE OR REFUSE
caption: Part two tomorrow. Comment TAKE or REFUSE. The majority writes part two.
